newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SAUDIS SEE OPEC 6-MONTH ROLLOVER - GULF SOURCE.
newsitem.headline: SAUDIS SEE OPEC 6-MONTH ROLLOVER - GULF SOURCE.

text.p: Saudi Arabia sees a rollover of OPEC's 25.033 million barrels per day (bpd) ceiling for the second half of the year as the likely outcome of this week's ministerial conference, a Gulf source said on Tuesday.
"All options are open but the most likely outcome is a rollover for six months," the source said.
"The market is right now healthy," the Gulf source told reporters.
"You cannot be certain but the most likely case is that prices will improve in the third quarter," when demand usually experiences a seasonal upturn.
The source said that although inventories were rising, global stocks were still lower than last year in terms of forward days demand cover.
"Even though we are optimistic about the price, optimism alone cannot increase it," he added.
He said that for the Saudis there were two issues -- the first being the uncertainty surrounding the resumption of Iraqi exports and the second the Saudi desire to see better prices.
